Fundingpips Clipping

FundingPips was built by traders, for traders. Our core philosophy is simple: Your ideas, our risk. Now, we are giving you full access to our official content vault unlocking raw global trader interviews, platform mechanics, and deep psychological breakdowns on what it takes to master discipline, clear evaluation phases, and manage up to $300,000 across multiple simulated accounts. If you understand the psychology of the charts and know how to construct high-impact, scroll-stopping loops, we will give you the raw ammunition. Take the footage, map out aggressive cuts, and show the internet what true risk management and scaling look like. Choose your file, engineer the hook, and claim your rewards. Speed wins.
